title: [GMCP 203.044.M] Mastery: Inspector, debugger, record/replay, mocks, and test laboratory
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-044-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: An operator can inspect negotiated capabilities, schemas, calls, subscriptions, tasks and traces; validate a server; replay a redacted deterministic transcript; inject latency/faults; and generate configurable mock clients or servers from contracts. Sensitive fields are removed before persistence, replay cannot perform side effects by default, formats are versioned, and CLI/TUI plus official Inspector workflows agree. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
